title: 8 Best AI Mobile App Builders in 2026: The 7-Criteria Study
summary: Eight AI mobile app builders scored across 7 criteria worth 70 points total. Every score checked against the vendor's own pricing pages, docs, and product pages.
body_markdown: Blink and Adalo both include a real, managed database on every plan, with Blink also wiring email, Google, and Apple sign-in automatically so a user's data follows them across devices. FlutterFlow and Rork both connect to a database, Firebase, Supabase, or Rork Cloud, though that's closer to a connected service than a single bundled store. Thunkable mostly relies on external sources like Firebase or Google Sheets, and Base44's backend was built for its web app, not a native mobile client.
